comment.en: The main cause is fog/low cloud: the US model forecasts visibility below 1000 m in many periods from 10/27 to 11/1, dropping to 51 m from 10/28 14:00 to 10/29 02:00. However, only the US model provides visibility, so no other model can confirm it; the highest gust across models is 17.9 kt, there is a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt, and rain peaks at 7.8 mm in 6 hours, so wind and heavy rain risks are low. Overall rating: Medium.

comment.en: The disruption risk over the next 5 days is mainly driven by fog/low clouds and is rated Medium. The US model forecasts low visibility across multiple periods, with visibility dropping to 100 m from 10/27 14:00 to 10/28 02:00 and down to 51 m from 10/28 14:00 to 10/29 02:00; in the fog vote, 1 of 1 model says Medium or above. comment.en: The main cause is strong wind. The airport forecast (TAF) gives temporary mean wind of 30 kt with gusts of 40 kt from 10/27 15:00 to 10/28 09:00, reaching the Medium threshold, with crosswind of 19.3 kt. However, all eight models rate it Low: the European model shows gusts of 30.2-34.4 kt and the US model 33.9-36.4 kt, with only a 0-1% chance of gusts over 49 kt. Although the chance of gusts over 29 kt reaches 100%, this still points to moderate wind. Winds ease after midday 10/28, and other periods show no rain, snow or fog signals, so overall disruption risk is rated Medium.

comment.en: The main cause of disruption risk over the next five days is strong winds and crosswind, rated Medium overall. Based on the three periods from 10/27 15:00–21:00 to 10/28 03:00–09:00 local, the official airport forecast (TAF) projects temporary mean wind of 30 kt, gusts of 40 kt, and crosswind of 19.3 kt, reaching Medium risk; during this time, the European model shows gusts up to 34.4 kt and the US model up to 36.4 kt, with a 100% chance of gusts over 29 kt, though only a 1% chance of gusts over 49 kt. Winds weaken from 10/28 09:00, with all models rating subsequent periods as Low.
